input: What happens if I delete my morning routine? Do not change anything.
replies:
If you delete your morning routine, it's removed permanently from My routines — there's no undo, so you'd have to recreate all the steps from scratch if you change your mind.

Your tasks, goals, reminders, and calendar events are unaffected; only the routine itself (its steps, order, and times) would be gone.
